messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

A student was shown this C code and question.

Code:
int a[3] = {4, 1, 7};
int t;
for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) { t = 0; t += a[i]; }

Question: What is t after the loop?
The student answered: 7

The student understands this correctly: Setting or declaring the total inside the loop wipes it on every pass, so only the last pass counts.

Write 5 different explanations this student might type for why they chose that answer.
Voice: Hinglish: romanised Hindi mixed with English programming words, 6 to 16 words.

Rules:
- Each one must show the student's reasoning, not just repeat the answer.
- Write as the student, in the first person or with no subject. Do not judge the answer or say it is wrong.
- Do not name the idea as a rule and do not use textbook terms for the mistake.
- Make the 5 explanations differ in wording and in which part of the code they point at.

Return JSON: {"sentences": ["...", "..."]}

content: {"sentences": ["Loop ke andar t = 0 har baar hota hai, isliye sirf last wala value bachta hai.", "Har iteration pe t zero ho jata hai, phir a[i] add hota hai, toh aakhri baar 7 hi milega.", "Jab loop chalta hai, pehle t ko 0 set karta hoon, phir a[i] jodta hoon, toh sirf 7 bachega.", "t = 0 loop ke andar likha hai, isliye pehle ke 4 aur 1 gayab ho jate hain, sirf 7 rehta hai.", "For loop ke har round mein t naya 0 se shuru hota hai, phir last element 7 add hota hai, bas wahi final hai."]}

sentences: Loop ke andar t = 0 har baar hota hai, isliye sirf last wala value bachta hai.
Har iteration pe t zero ho jata hai, phir a[i] add hota hai, toh aakhri baar 7 hi milega.
Jab loop chalta hai, pehle t ko 0 set karta hoon, phir a[i] jodta hoon, toh sirf 7 bachega.
t = 0 loop ke andar likha hai, isliye pehle ke 4 aur 1 gayab ho jate hain, sirf 7 rehta hai.
For loop ke har round mein t naya 0 se shuru hota hai, phir last element 7 add hota hai, bas wahi final hai.
